pkg.name: STOCK-AUDIT-2-TEST-PREPARATION

policy.missingFormula: F0103 gross purchase - F0102 verified goods entry 90/32
policy.otherInbounds: Count/opening/return/unknown adjustment requires evidence of relation; never subtract only because quantities match
policy.coverageAuthority: Only explicit owner confirmation or verified source document relationship; same-day quantity alone is insufficient
policy.safeMeaning: Eligible for isolated TEST preparation under verified rule; not live approval or physical-count proof
policy.testBaseline: Effective inventory view and product card agree with Vega movement balance; inherited cutover snapshot is baseline, not independent purchase compensation

executionPrerequisites: Explicit approval of this exact hashed TEST package
Fresh source and TEST identity, row versions, quantities, and coverage checks
Verified current TEST backup and transactional rollback plan
Native audited quantity-adjustment API with persistent unique idempotency key; no direct SQL posting
Preserve old purchase/entry rows, baseline opening, terminal receipts, finance, cost and history
Replay with same key must create zero new effects
Fail closed on quantity drift, prior correction, mapping change or any unresolved cost handling
